title: New Mexico Statutes Annotated 1978, Chapter 50 (Employment Law), Article 17 - Healthy Workplaces (the Healthy Workplaces Act)
verified_how: Same chapter page as above (item 4420, browser, 23 September 2026, collection 'Current New Mexico Statutes Annotated 1978', date 2026): the table of contents lists 'ARTICLE 17 Healthy Workplaces' as the last article of the chapter, with no '(Repealed.)' marker, alongside 'ARTICLE 16 Caregiver Leave'.
notes: This is New Mexico's paid-sick-leave statute (the Healthy Workplaces Act), the state's principal leave entitlement for private-sector employees. Article 16, Caregiver Leave, is a narrower companion. New Mexico has no statutory paid public-holiday entitlement for private employers - holiday pay is contractual - so this Act is the closest match for the topic rather than an exact one.
